name: Emulator & tests
tagline: A local fake GitHub for demos and e2e tests
summary: A local stand-in for GitHub with a seeded demo workspace. It lets anyone run the whole app, and the Playwright tests, with no GitHub account and no network.

flow.label: pnpm dev:demo
flow.note: Starts the emulator on port 4001, waits for the seed, then starts the dashboard on 3000.

flow.label: Emulator server
flow.note: Boots emulate's GitHub service and registers DiffKit's shim routes ahead of it.

flow.label: Workspace seed
flow.note: Creates six people, the lumen-labs org and six repos with PRs, issues and CI runs.

flow.label: Emulator switch
flow.note: With GITHUB_EMULATOR_URL set, Octokit's base URL and the OAuth flow use the emulator.

flow.label: GraphQL shim
flow.note: Answers the dashboard's GraphQL queries from the same store using graphql-js.

flow.label: Playwright suite
flow.note: Starts both servers, signs in as nova and runs 20 spec files in two projects.

features.name: Emulated GitHub API
features.summary: REST, OAuth and GitHub App auth come from @emulators/github. DiffKit shims add notifications, installations, statuses, PR diffs, zipped logs and settings.

features.name: GraphQL shim
features.summary: A schema covering exactly the fields DiffKit selects, resolved against the emulator's store. A test runs every GraphQL document found in lib/github.

features.name: Seeded workspace
features.summary: You sign in as nova. The lumen-labs org has beacon, orbit, handbook, infra and atlas, plus nova/dotfiles. Dates hang off a fixed anchor so ids repeat.

features.name: One-variable switch
features.summary: GITHUB_EMULATOR_URL is the only switch. It is refused in production builds and for any host that is not localhost.

features.name: Demo mode script
features.summary: pnpm dev:demo runs emulator and dashboard together with committed throwaway credentials. Demo D1, KV and R2 state is kept apart from normal dev state.

features.name: Playwright suite
features.summary: 20 spec files: 8 read-only ones run in parallel; 12 that write or depend on timing run one at a time, with the emulator reset before each test.

features.name: Sample data for skeletons
features.summary: Separate from the emulator: 21 *-samples.ts files feed made-up rows to real components inside SkeletonSample, which tells them not to fetch.
